name: Paperclip
short_desc: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents
author: Paperclip Labs
description: Paperclip is an open-source control plane for orchestrating teams of AI agents. It provides task management, organizational structure, budgets, governance, scheduled heartbeats, persistent workspaces, and an audit trail from a single web dashboard.

form_fields.hint: Optional. Enables local Claude agent runs. It can also be configured later in Paperclip.
